svg.aria-label: The ICR in a country's campaign systems: campaign tools plan and collect, the ICR keeps the registry and the record, DHIS2 and the warehouse report.
svg.title: The ICR in a country's campaign systems: campaign tools plan and collect, the ICR keeps the registry and the record, DHIS2 and the warehouse report.
svg.text: THE ICR IN A COUNTRY'S CAMPAIGN SYSTEMS
data going out of the ICR, or between tools
SYSTEM OF RECORD · HL7 FHIR R4
tool's own codes map to them

g.text: DHIS2 org units and historical campaign data load the ICR's location registry and campaign data.
Crosscut reads locations and target populations from the ICR to make microplans,
and sends catchment areas back to the location registry.
Collection tools get the campaign plan, targets and shared codes from the ICR,
run the campaign with their own forms, and send results back. DHIS2 sends its campaign data and any changes, such as a new facility.
The ICR sends aggregate results to DHIS2 and exports Parquet files to the warehouse,
which dashboards and BI tools read.
The next round starts from the registry: locations, populations and past results
don't have to be collected again.
